strings.name: Zhou Qunfei
strings.role: Chairwoman and general manager of Lens Technology
strings.summary: Zhou Qunfei is a Chinese manufacturing entrepreneur, co-founder of Lens Technology and its chairwoman and general manager. Starting in glass processing, she led the company’s development of protective glass, structural components, functional modules and assembly for electronic devices. Listed in Shenzhen and Hong Kong, Lens Technology is a manufacturer in the global electronics supply chain.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. The early factory, Shenzhen Lens and the listed entity are distinguished, with cofounding and joint control retained. Company finances are not personal wealth; an agenda does not prove attendance.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Lens Technology, advancing precision glass and electronic-device component manufacturing within the global smart-device supply chain.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education and status
strings.facts.f1.value: The annual report lists a junior-college qualification, Chinese nationality and Hong Kong permanent residency; the qualification is not recast as a bachelor’s degree.
strings.facts.f2.label: Two stock-market listings
strings.facts.f2.value: Shenzhen ChiNext A-shares trade as 300433 and Hong Kong Main Board H-shares as 6613, listed in 2015 and 2025 respectively.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Glass processing and precision manufacturing
strings.highlights.h1.text: Developed from an early glass-processing factory into protective glass and component manufacturing; company achievements include contributions from teams and partners.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Expansion of business scope
strings.highlights.h2.text: The company reports structural components, functional modules and complete-device assembly for consumer electronics, intelligent vehicles and other sectors.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Company reports nine-month results
strings.timeline.t1.text: Unaudited revenue for the first nine months is about RMB47.902 billion and attributable net profit RMB1.420 billion, down 10.74% and 50.06% year on year.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Participates in annual results briefing
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company’s activity record lists her among managers meeting investors; the discussion covers operations and finance.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Lens H-shares list in Hong Kong
strings.timeline.t3.text: Trading begins on the Hong Kong Main Board as 6613, distinct from the existing Shenzhen A-share listing.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Lens lists on Shenzhen ChiNext
strings.timeline.t4.text: A-shares begin trading as 300433; this is separate from her early entrepreneurship and incorporation dates.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes chairwoman and general manager
strings.timeline.t5.text: The annual report dates her tenure to June 2011; the joint-stock company’s incorporation date is separately June 29.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Hunan corporate entity established
strings.timeline.t6.text: The listing announcement dates the issuer’s predecessor to this day, not the beginning of her entrepreneurial career.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founds Shenzhen Lens
strings.timeline.t7.text: Develops Shenzhen Lens Technology with Zheng Junlong and others, focusing on protective glass manufacturing.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Establishes Hengsheng glass factory
strings.timeline.t8.text: Begins glass-processing entrepreneurship in Shenzhen, before the establishment of Lens Technology.
